description: For a trip to several countries (or several phones): turns 2 to 6 plan_ids from find_esim_plans into one cart link. The customer opens it, checks the eSIMs and pays once on Stripe; each eSIM comes in its own QR email and can be refunded on its own if never installed. 3 or more eSIMs in one cart are 5% off. Nothing is bought until the customer pays on the page.

plan_ids.description: plan_ids from find_esim_plans, one per eSIM, e.g. ['japan-5gb-30d', 'south-korea-3gb-30d'].

name: make_esim_cart

cart_url.description: Give this link to the customer: they pay for every eSIM in it at once.

countries.description: Regional and global plans: how many countries they cover.

total_usd.description: What the cart page charges, with the 5% off that 3+ eSIMs get on most plans. A partner code may lower it on the page.

title: One payment for several eSIMs
